# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 3
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 3

---

1. When the Lord had spoken these things, I fell upon my face and wept, and said: "O Lord, as you have said — is it possible that a person who commits sin may repent and be saved? And what of those who die in their sins?"

2. The Lord answered me: "The sinners will repent when they see those who are believed in. Likewise, those who did not believe will see those who believed, and will be ashamed of their unbelief.

3. Those who repent will be saved, and they will dwell with the righteous in the glory of my Father. But those who persist in their sin will be judged and condemned to punishment in accordance with their deeds."

4. I said: "O Lord, allow me to see what happens to the souls of sinners and the righteous when they depart from this world."

5. The Lord showed me a great angel, terrible in appearance, who held in his right hand a fiery sword; fire poured forth from his body.

6. Beside him were two other angels; and above them was another, more radiant and glorious than they. These were charged with the souls of sinners.

7. The other angels were luminous and clothed in light. They received the souls of the righteous, who praised God with a great voice.

8. The angel of righteousness brought forward the souls of the righteous and presented them before me. I saw their faces shining like the sun.

9. I said to the Lord: "Who are these?"

10. The Lord said to me: "These are your brothers, the righteous ones, whose works are not yet known to you. Yet they are known to me."

11. I asked: "What of the sinners, Lord? Where are they taken?"

12. The Lord answered me: "The sinners are taken by the angel who presides over punishment and are led to the place of torment."

---
*LOGOS note: "Place of punishment/torment" — the Greek Tartaros tradition underlies the Ethiopic language here. LOGOS preserves the formal distinction between the bright angels and the terrible punishing angel.*
